purpose: Remove mandatory AI-provider availability from merge readiness while retaining actual independent review and manual SHA-bound merges.
requiredInvariants: AI-provider quota, availability and absence of AI review cannot veto engineering readiness.
Actual independent review of the exact current diff is mandatory before each manual merge and is recorded without impersonating a native reviewer.
Engineering readiness is not independent-review approval or automatic-merge authorization.
Legacy automatic merge callers fail closed; native auto-merge must be disabled.
Full exact-head substantive CI/security, owner audit, current unresolved findings and active changes requests remain enforced.
GitHub server-side protections remain active and no forced merge or fabricated status is allowed.
This owner-authorized policy transition is reviewed and tested transparently; an obsolete AI-only rule does not require an AI provider to remove itself.
IR-20 remains active until verified REG.RU PRODUCTION_PASS; no later delivery slice is unlocked.
